name: Kamino Institutional USDC
description: Kamino Institutional Yield is an overcollateralized institutional lending product. USDC deposited into the vault flows through a special-purpose vehicle to a regulated lending operation supervised by the Financial Market Authority (FMA) in Liechtenstein, which originates loans to KYC-verified institutional borrowers against Bitcoin collateral held at qualified custodians.

Every loan is capped at 60% LTV — typically lower in practice. Loan duration is fixed at 30, 60, or 90 days, with the rate set at origination for each term and held constant until rollover. There is no collateral ownership transfer to the lender, and rehypothecation of collateral is contractually prohibited. Custodians hold collateral in segregated accounts and enforce the tripartite agreement independently of borrower and lending operation.

Yield reaches depositors via share-value appreciation as interest accrues to the vault on a 365-day basis. Redemptions within the on-chain liquidity buffer settle immediately; larger withdrawals enter an on-chain FIFO queue that resolves as underlying loans mature. Live per-loan data — collateral asset, loan amount, mark-to-market collateral value, and per-loan LTV — is exposed on the vault UI and matches the same source the regulator monitors. An independent accounting firm publishes a monthly attestation against the same data.

name: OnRe Tokenized Reinsurance
description: OnRe Tokenized Reinsurance (ONyc) is a fully composable, yield-bearing asset representing a proportional share of a regulated segregated account that underwrites short-duration property reinsurance with worldwide catastrophe exposure. ONyc generates returns from reinsurance premiums and collateral income, bringing a liquid, scalable, and historically uncorrelated source of real-world yield to DeFi. All funds are subject to a multisig regime. The investment vehicle structure is legally ringfenced and bankruptcy remote.
Subscriptions and redemptions with OnRe settle instantly in USDG, none to subscribe and 0.30% to redeem, open to non-u.s. institutional investors and non-u.s. professional investors, KYC required.

On Re SAC Ltd. is a Bermuda-domiciled company registered as a Segregated Accounts Company (SAC). Under this structure, each account operates as a distinct pool of assets and liabilities that are statutorily segregated under Bermuda law. While not separate legal entities, these accounts are treated independently for asset and liability purposes, ensuring that capital is properly allocated and managed in accordance with Bermuda’s regulatory framework. Each segregated account is maintained as a distinct pool of assets and liabilities, and creditors of one account (or of the general account) have no recourse to the assets of another. Similarly, account owners and other counterparties have no claim against the general assets of the company, ensuring that the capital within each account is insulated from unrelated liabilities within the broader corporate structure.

name: PRIME

By holding PRIME, you earn the prevailing rate in the Home Equity Pool (minus the 50 bps Hastra Platform Fee) which derives its yield from real borrower interest payments.
Hastra platform fee of 50 bps deducted from yield. Subscriptions and redemptions with Hastra settle instantly in PYUSD, no issuer fees, open to non-US investors and US investors, no KYC.

name: AUTO

name: Apollo Diversified Credit Securitize Fund

name: Matrixdock Gold
description: Each XAUm token represents 1 troy oz. of 99.99% purity LBMA gold stored in reputable vaults in Asia with physical redemption options. A NFT version which has a fixed allocation to a specific bar can be minted using required number of XAUm tokens.

XAUm is a digital token with a 1:1 peg to 1 fine troy ounce weight of LBMA gold, fully backed and stored in reputable vaults located in Asia. There is no management fee for XAUm in both ERC-20/BEP-20 and NFT forms. Mint fee is waived before XAUm TVL reaches $100M. A redemption fee of 0.25% is applicable. Subscriptions and redemptions with Matrixdock settle daily in USD, none to subscribe and 0.25% to redeem, minimum $10,000, open to non-US investors, KYC required.

Matrixdock has set up a special purpose trust  to hold the XAUm entities (i.e. the token issuer and asset holder). This legal structure serves to ring fence the XAUm investors’ assets from any creditor’s claims in the unlikely event of Matrixport’s insolvency. The Matrixdock Gold entities are special purpose vehicles which only conduct the Matrixdock Gold program, and incur no liabilities other than the obligations toward XAUm token holders. They would not be subject to any claims from Matrixdock creditors even in the unlikely event that Matrixdock is insolvent.
